findings.title: Bankable PC accepted as fixed VDP OUT site
findings.observed: validate_features and instrumentation accept pc=0x03FF or0x1000 and only compare ROM file bytes; generated breakpoint commands have no live opcode guard.
findings.why: Official Sega mapper fixes only first1024bytes; laterbankchanges alter logical bytes0400–3FFF. An event can be labeled vdp_io_before_out at a site executing another instruction. Codemasters also prevents universal fixedlowbank assumption.
findings.recommendation: Require qualified mapper+fullyfixed2byte site, or validate exact live opcode bytes for every hit; preserve mismatch/skipped scope and count. Add a bank-switch negative fixture.
findings.retest: PC03FF/1000 rejected; two-byte<=03FE bounds and live Z80byte guard present; injected SITE_MISMATCH makes audit fail. OUT(C),r filter nested inside opcode guard. Identity/routine equivalence with same opcode remains outside scope.

findings.title: Impossible VDP internal event values accepted
findings.observed: Complete rebound synthetic bundle with vcounter/hslot/address/cd=99999 passes audit.
findings.why: NoCPUresync permits stalephase, not values impossible for storedfieldtypes. vcounter is uint16,hslot/cd uint8 in vdp.h.
findings.recommendation: Validate source-type ranges for each raw internal field, without claiming CPU alignment; add negative event fixtures. Address is uint32, so use actual qualified bound or type scope rather than inventing14bit for internal state.
findings.retest: Same preserved 99999 internals fixture now structuredFAIL; source-type bounds present.
